```{r}
map <- st_read(here::here("data", "shape_data", "World_Countries_Generalized.shp"))

map
```

```{r}
# scrape country codes
codeurl <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes"

# read in page
page1 <- read_html(codeurl)

tables <- page1 |>
  html_elements("table")

# code table
table1 <- tables[[1]] |>
  html_table(fill = TRUE)

codes <- table1 |>
  select(Country = `ISO 3166[1]name[5]`,
         ISO2 = 3,
         ISO3 = 4) |> 
  slice(-1)

codes <- codes |> 
  mutate(across(ISO2, 
                ~ ifelse(nchar(.) > 3, 
                         NA, .)),
         across(ISO3, 
                ~ ifelse(nchar(.) > 3, 
                         NA, .)))
```
